annotations.title: HelloFresh: change one week’s box size

description: Change the box size (people, and optionally meals) of ONE HelloFresh delivery week only — the plan stays as it is (hf_change_plan_size changes it for good, and resets these one-week sizes). Keeps the week’s delivery day. The subscription’s first box cannot be resized (a HelloFresh rule) and is refused. HelloFresh may reset that week’s meal picks; the result says so, and hf_select_meals re-picks. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

meals.description: Meals per week for this week (default: the week’s current count).

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_set_week_size
